task_title: PERF-001: resolve tsx binary directly instead of npx in tests/cli.test.ts + pin tsx in devDependencies
task_criteria: tests/cli.test.ts resolves the CLI runner through node_modules/.bin/tsx (no 'npx tsx' in the CLI constant)
package.json devDependencies pins tsx 4.23.15 and node_modules/.bin/tsx exists after install

TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/cli.test.ts --reporter=dot passes the whole file (43 passed | 2 skipped with the current test set; 41 passed | 2 skipped was the count at the row base commit, 2 tests were added later by e570bfcf) and is materially faster than the npx arm: back-to-back on the same host, npx 32.20s at loadavg 18.74 vs direct binary 22.46s at loadavg 17.85 (row baseline 38.90s with no local tsx installed)

items.criterion: tests/cli.test.ts resolves the CLI runner through node_modules/.bin/tsx (no 'npx tsx' in the CLI constant)
items.detail: tests/cli.test.ts:127 `const TSX_BIN = path.join(REPO_ROOT, "node_modules", ".bin", "tsx");` and :128 `const CLI = `${TSX_BIN} --tsconfig ${tmpConfigPath} ${path.join(REPO_ROOT, "src", "cli", "index.ts")}`;`. `grep -n "npx" tests/cli.test.ts` returns only line 125, a comment ("invoke the repo-local tsx binary directly instead of via `npx`"). Commit c1be3bf9's diff shows the removed line `-const CLI = `npx tsx --tsconfig ...`` replaced by the TSX_BIN form. All 40+ cliExec call sites (lines 143-537) interpolate `${CLI}`. [resolution 0.03; tests/cli.test.ts]

items.criterion: package.json devDependencies pins tsx 4.23.15 and node_modules/.bin/tsx exists after install

items.detail: Same run as criterion 3: `Tests  43 passed | 2 skipped (45)` with 0 failures and `Test Files  1 passed (1)`; the 2 skips are pre-existing `it.skip` for unimplemented `search --json`/`--quiet` (tests/cli.test.ts:148,156). No ENOENT/spawn errors in output.

items.criterion: The pinned tsx is installed by the repo's CI install path so node_modules/.bin/tsx exists in CI, not only on this host
items.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yml:50 `run: npm ci`; package-lock.json:47 pins root devDependency tsx 4.23.15 and packages["node_modules/tsx"] 4.23.15, so `npm ci` materialises node_modules/.bin/tsx (bin entry `tsx: dist/cli.mjs` at package-lock.json:7029). `npm ls tsx` -> `tsx@4.23.15 deduped`.

items.criterion: No other path that the CLI test runner depends on still spawns `npx tsx` (the optimisation is not silently bypassed)
items.detail: Repo-wide `grep -rn "npx tsx"` (excluding node_modules/.tmp/.vfs/.gitreins/history) returns only scripts/e2e/seed-to-artifacts.sh:31 and the comment at scripts/e2e/seed-to-artifacts.driver.ts:4 — an unrelated e2e driver, not the CLI runner. bin/speclang (used via CLI_BIN) contains no `npx tsx` (only ts-node hints at bin/speclang:142,203).

items.criterion: Verification left the working tree unmodified (no leftover mutation of the test file or manifests)
items.detail: After the temporary npx-arm experiment the file was restored from backup; `git status --porcelain tests/ package.json package-lock.json` returns empty output, and tests/cli.test.ts:127-128 again show the TSX_BIN form.
